doc: See which layers a frame is made of, take its pixels, and go from a pixel back to what drew it.

tools.name: frame.layers
tools.description: The frame's size, its pixels' hash, and its layers from the back: each one's name, how much it drew, what it could not draw, whether it keeps what drew each pixel

tools.name: frame.capture
tools.description: The pixels as drawn — the whole frame or a region of it — as a PNG in base64; at most 4 megapixels a request

region.description: [x, y, width, height] in the frame's pixels (the whole frame when none is given)

tools.name: frame.at
tools.description: What drew a pixel: its colour, and the chain from it back — the topmost layer that keeps what drew each pixel, and that layer's object there; of a layer in three dimensions also the instance, its mesh and material, the cluster, the triangle, the depth and the normal

tasks.name: see-what-the-frame-is-made-of
tasks.summary: Read the frame's size and its layers from the back

tasks.name: look-at-the-pixels
tasks.summary: Take a corner of the frame as a picture

tasks.name: ask-what-drew-a-pixel
tasks.summary: Go from a pixel back to the layer and the object that drew it
